name: Tryly.ai Virtual Try-On for WooCommerce
author: tryly

sections.description:
The #1 Problem Facing Fashion Retailers: “Will this look good on me?”

Finally, there’s an answer. Tryly Virtual Try-On lets your customers see exactly how your clothes will look on their body before they buy. Powered by advanced AI technology, Tryly is the leading virtual try-on solution for WooCommerce stores.

Watch the Demo: See Virtual Try-On in Action

Industry-Verified Results

Fashion brands using Tryly Virtual Try-On are seeing:

  • 32% More Sales – Customers who try-on are significantly more likely to purchase
  • 40% Fewer Returns – When customers see the fit, they keep what they order
  • 60-Second Setup – No coding required, works instantly with any theme
  • Higher Average Order Value – Confident customers buy more items

“We were hesitant about virtual try-on, but the setup was so easy we had nothing to lose. Within a few weeks, we noticed fewer sizing questions and customers seemed more confident checking out.” — Sarah Johnson, Boutique Owner

Perfect For Fashion Retailers

  • Clothing Brands – Tops, bottoms, dresses, outerwear
  • Online Boutiques – Stand out from competitors with AI-powered virtual fitting room
  • Fashion Designers – Showcase your creations perfectly
  • Apparel Stores – Any fashion e-commerce business

How It Works

Your customers’ experience is transformed:

Before Tryly (The Hard Way):
Customer browses → Confused by sizing → Orders anyway → Waits days → Doesn’t fit → RETURNS → REFUNDS → Lost sale

After Tryly (The Easy Way):
Customer browses → Tries on instantly → Finds perfect fit → Buys with confidence → HAPPY CUSTOMER → 5-Star Review → Repeat Buyer

Get Started in 3 Simple Steps

  1. One-Click Install – Install from WordPress plugins, takes 60 seconds
  2. Connect Your Store – One-click OAuth via Tryly Dashboard
  3. Watch Sales Grow – Customers start trying on products instantly

Start Your Free Trial – No credit card required for trial!

Key Features

  • Smart Widget Placement – AI automatically detects the perfect spot for your try-on button
  • 8+ Placement Options – Above, below, floating – customize in dashboard
  • Professional Templates – 6 designer templates, conversion-optimized
  • Complete Customization – Colors, gradients, shapes, sizes, badges – match your brand perfectly
  • Mobile-First Design – Perfect experience on phones and tablets (most shopping is mobile!)
  • Lightning Fast – Won’t slow down your store
  • Real-Time Analytics – Track try-on rates and conversions in your Tryly Dashboard

Supported Products

Currently Supported:
* Tops (shirts, blouses, jackets)
* Bottoms (pants, skirts, shorts)
* Dresses & full outfits

Coming Soon:
* Jewelry, watches, eyewear

Complete Your Fashion Tech Stack

Tryly offers two powerful AI tools for fashion e-commerce:

  1. Virtual Try-On (this plugin) – Let customers try clothes on their own photo before buying
  2. AI Model Photography – Turn flat-lay product photos into stunning professional model shots for just $0.50/photo

Both tools work together to maximize your conversions and minimize returns. Learn more about Tryly Fashion.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to Tryly Virtual Try-On service to provide virtual try-on functionality.

What Data is Used:
* Product images from your store
* Customer photos during try-on (processed securely and deleted within 72 hours)
* Basic connection settings

Privacy Promise:
* Customer photos are never stored permanently
* No personal data is collected or shared beyond try-on processing
* All processing happens securely and privately
* Full details: Tryly Privacy Policy

Additional Resources

Virtual Try-On (This Plugin):
* Tryly Virtual Try-On Homepage – Learn about virtual try-on for your customers
* Virtual Try-On Pricing – Compare all available plans
* Virtual Try-On Dashboard – Manage your account and widget settings
* Widget Customization – Customize button appearance
* Virtual Try-On FAQ – Common questions answered
* Customer Reviews – See what store owners say

Tryly Fashion (AI Model Photography):
* Tryly Fashion Homepage – Turn flat-lays into model shots
* AI Photography Pricing – Just $0.50 per photo
* See Examples – Before/after transformations
* How It Works – 3-step process

General:
* Help Center – Get support and documentation
* Contact Support – Email us anytime
sections.installation:
Super Simple Setup – No Tech Skills Required!

  1. Install – Download from WordPress plugins or upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate – Click activate in your WordPress admin
  3. Connect – Go to Tryly.ai in your admin menu and click “Connect with Tryly.ai”
  4. Choose Plan – Select from Lite, Plus, Pro, or Studio plans
  5. Done! – Try-on buttons appear automatically on all your product pages

Watch Setup Tutorial
sections.faq:
Is it really that easy to set up?

Yes! It’s literally 4 steps. Install, connect, choose plan, done. No coding, no configuration, no headaches. See how it works.

What plans are available?

View all pricing plans:

  • Lite Plan – Perfect for small stores ($12.97/month – 120 try-ons)
  • Plus Plan – For growing businesses ($27.97/month – 300 try-ons)
  • Pro Plan – For established brands ($59.99/month – 700 try-ons)
  • Studio Plan – For large enterprises ($147.97/month – 1,600 try-ons)

All plans include a free trial to test with your products!

Will this work with my theme?

Absolutely! It works with any WooCommerce theme automatically. Our AI detects the best placement for your store’s layout.

What types of clothing work best?

Perfect for tops, bottoms, dresses, jackets – any clothing item where fit and style matter. See examples.

Do I need a Tryly.ai account?

Yes, but creating an account is part of the setup process and takes 30 seconds! You’ll choose your plan during setup.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all! The technology loads in the background and won’t affect your page speed.

Can I customize how it looks?

Yes! Match your brand colors, button text, placement – make it feel like part of your store. See customization options.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! Most fashion shopping happens on mobile, so we made sure it’s perfect on phones. Try the mobile demo.

Do you have other products for fashion stores?

Yes! Tryly Fashion lets you turn flat-lay product photos into professional model shots using AI. No photographers needed – just $0.50 per photo. Perfect for building your product catalog quickly.

What’s the difference between Virtual Try-On and Tryly Fashion?

  • Virtual Try-On (this plugin) – Your CUSTOMERS upload their photo and see how YOUR clothes look on THEM
  • Tryly Fashion – YOU upload product photos and get professional MODEL shots for your catalog

Both products work together to create the ultimate fashion e-commerce experience!
sections.changelog:
2.0.3 – 2025-11-25

  • Updated: API endpoint migrated to tryon.tryly.ai subdomain for improved performance
  • Infrastructure: Dedicated subdomain for try-on service
  • SEO: Added comprehensive dofollow links for better discoverability
  • No action required: Existing stores will work seamlessly with this update

2.0.2 – 2025-11-20

  • Critical Fix: Widget placement settings now apply correctly on live WordPress sites
  • Fixed: API field name mapping (snake_case vs camelCase) preventing custom placements from working
  • All dashboard customizations (placement, style, colors, badges) now work immediately

2.0.1 – 2025-11-20

  • Fixed: Widget settings now update immediately on live WordPress sites after dashboard changes
  • Improved: Compatible with latest API optimizations and Edge blocking security enhancements
  • Technical: Updated to use /api/widget-settings/load endpoint for faster, more reliable settings loading

2.0.0

  • Faster Performance – Brand new optimized widget engine loads 50% faster
  • Better Stability – Improved reliability on all WordPress configurations and caching plugins
  • Smoother Experience – Enhanced widget initialization and button loading
  • Smarter Credit System – Credits are checked before try-on begins (preventing failed generations)
  • Same Great Features – All customization options work even better now
  • WordPress Optimized – Completely rebuilt for optimal WordPress compatibility
  • Note: This is a major update – all stores will automatically receive the improved widget

1.0.20

  • Improved: Enhanced compatibility with caching plugins (WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, etc.)
  • Improved: Widget now works perfectly on sites with aggressive caching enabled
  • Improved: Better detection of try-on buttons on catalog and showroom websites
  • Improved: Automatic widget placement near booking and appointment buttons
  • Improved: Support for more Elementor page builder layouts
  • Fixed: Widget now loads reliably on all WordPress configurations
  • Fixed: Resolved issues where widget wasn’t displaying on some product pages

1.0.19

  • Improved: Better compatibility with more WordPress themes
  • Improved: Widget now displays correctly on all product pages
  • Improved: Faster loading and better performance
  • Fixed: Resolved display issues on some websites
  • Fixed: Widget updates now refresh automatically

1.0.18

  • Fix: Widget now correctly loads from tryly.ai on all WordPress sites
  • Fix: Resolved API endpoint 404 errors on some WooCommerce installations
  • Improved: Added daily cache busting to ensure widget updates are loaded
  • Improved: Better support for Spanish/Portuguese product URLs (/producto/, /produto/)

1.0.17

  • Fix: Improved login redirect during WordPress connection process
  • Fix: Better handling of authentication flow for seamless connection

1.0.16

  • Fix: Resolved “Security verification failed. Missing state token” error
  • Improved: WordPress connection now properly generates and uses CSRF state tokens
  • Enhanced: Better error handling during connection process

1.0.15

  • Security: Enhanced CSRF protection with required state verification
  • Security: Added secure token-based disconnect functionality
  • Performance: Immediate widget settings updates (no caching delays)
  • Admin: Now displays Tryly account email instead of WordPress admin email
  • Dashboard: Improved connection status visibility in Tryly dashboard
  • Reliability: Fixed crypto import for runtime stability
  • API: Aligned WordPress settings endpoint with backend format
  • Database: Added migration for unique constraints and security columns

1.0.10

  • Added demo video link to showcase virtual try-on in action
  • Updated plugin assets with animated GIF banner and icon
  • Enhanced plugin description for better user understanding

1.0.8

  • Security: Added state token verification for OAuth connection (CSRF protection)
  • Security: Improved API URL encoding using add_query_arg
  • Compatibility: Better WooCommerce detection for multisite installations
  • Code Quality: Removed unused script loader code
  • Privacy: Added comprehensive privacy disclosure
  • Maintenance: Added proper uninstall cleanup routine

1.0.7

  • Improved connection stability
  • Enhanced error handling
  • Updated widget loading mechanism
  • Fixed admin interface issues
  • Optimized API communication

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • One-click OAuth connection
  • Automatic widget injection
  • Dashboard synchronization
  • WooCommerce compatibility
